subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should #38364 remain the umbrella for Control UI structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it into the narrower #90745 reply-metadata path and #87561 final-fallback contract?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI, gateway protocol, agent runtime context, and final delivery semantics, and current main only implements partial text-based behavior.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let #87561 own the no-output/final-fallback semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after explicitly confirming the reply metadata and no-output portions are fully tracked by narrower open items.

options.title: Accept Markdown Quote As Enough
options.body: Treat the current UI quote text as sufficient and leave structured reply identity to channel-specific work, which narrows scope but does not satisfy the original metadata request.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let #87561 own the no-output/final-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest available routing candidate from current-main broad-surface history, while concrete implementation ownership remains shared across UI, runtime, and delivery surfaces.
